terms.meaning: a short code that lets someone join a crew

used_by: src/app/crews/[crewId]/CrewAdmin.tsx (the New code button; not confirmed in this route)

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Make a new invite code handler
sections.what: Creates a fresh invite code for the named crew for the signed-in caller and returns it.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the New code button.
sections.watch_out: Every old invite link stops working as soon as the new code is made.

summary: Creates a new invite code for a crew, which replaces the old code.
purpose: Lets a crew owner cancel an invite code that has leaked or is no longer wanted.
why: The crew admin page says old links and codes stop working after a new code is made, so this route makes that possible.
how: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Reads the crew id from the address. 3) Calls the rotate service and returns its result as JSON.
inputs: A POST with the crew id in the address. The caller comes from the session.
outputs: A JSON result containing the new invite code.
risks: Old invite codes stop working at once, so an accidental click breaks shared invites.
debug: If the code does not change, check the rotate function in the crews service and the owner rule it applies.
